title: Scholar Athlete of the Week: Copperas Cove's Isabella Hunt - NewsBreak
text:
By Victoria Samuels ,
1 hours ago
COPPERAS COVE, Texas ( FOX 44 ) — Some high school athletes make their mark on the scoreboard. Others do it in the classroom.
Copperas Cove senior Isabella Hunt apparently decided there was no reason she couldn't do both ... and while she was at it, throw in a little agricultural leadership and plans to own a business someday.
As a pitcher and outfielder for the Lady Bulldawgs, Hunt has been rewriting the school record books.
In 2024, she set Copperas Cove's single-season fielding percentage record. A year later, she established another school record for most runs scored in a season and earned recognition as a Class 6A preseason player to watch.
Apparently, keeping opponents from scoring wasn't enough. She wanted to make sure she crossed home plate plenty of times herself.
And her success doesn't stop when she leaves the softball diamond.
Hunt is a three-time academic all-district selection who has already completed 18 hours of college credit through Tarleton State University.
She's also president and a founding member of Copperas Cove's Future Farmers of America chapter.
After graduation, Hunt plans to attend Texas A&M University, major in agribusiness and eventually open her own farm-to-table business.
Having grown up around livestock, Hunt loves animals, cooking and baking. She figures combining those interests into a career makes more sense than choosing just one.
But Hunt says some of her most valuable lessons have come from softball, where she's learned discipline, time management and how to remain composed while juggling athletics, academics and leadership responsibilities.
And as a senior, she understands her job isn't just helping the Lady Bulldawgs win games. It's helping younger teammates develop the confidence and character to carry on the program's traditions.
Because Hunt knows success isn't just about the records you break. It's about the example you set and the people you help along the way.
And whether her future takes her to the softball field, the classroom or the farm ... this Lady Bulldawg is making sure she's got all her bases covered.
And that's why Isabella Hunt is our Week 6 CTWP Scholar Athlete of the Week .
